The cover plate and the schematic are host-composed, deterministic artwork built from the Atlas Lamp token palette; no third-party imagery is bundled. The narration clip is synthetic speech from Kokoro-82M voice jf_alpha (Apache-2.0), generated offline by the pack maintainer; no human speaker was recorded. Sources are cited by link and are not bundled; see sources[] and content/source-notes.md.

items.outcome: Choose the Japanese expression that fits the person you are speaking to, and say why it fits.
items.creator_note: Written as the sample L0 classroom: four lines, three addressees, one decision. Original teaching text; the only bundled media are a synthetic narration clip and a deterministic relationship map.
will_not_teach: Kanji beyond the lines each section writes out; every Japanese line carries romaji and an English meaning.
Native-speaker pronunciation: the bundled clip is synthetic speech, and the pack says so.
Listening or speaking assessment: no listening or pronunciation evidence is graded here.

changelog.note: A Press Plate cover (16:9 master plus its mechanical 3:2 crop) is linked as the pack's first visual, so the Store, the Library row and the course detail present the same plate. Five flat inks, no text, no object: the plate carries no register facts, and the relationship map remains the deterministic schematic.
cb.pack v2: the narration clip and the relationship map are declared as media[] links with text equivalents. The fourth objective became a closed A/B/C check, so the course has no ungradable section.
First bundled sample: three sections on register and addressee.

items.outcome: Read a measuring jug and double a quantity, with a parent guiding and the answers kept off the learner page.
items.creator_note: Prepared for a parent to run, not for a child talking to a tutor. The learner page carries the two tasks; the answer guide is a separate file the manifest declares by role.
will_not_teach: Fractions, unit conversion or reading a scale finer than the 50 ml marks.
Any hazard: the pack uses water and a jug, with no heat, sharp tools or chemicals.
A child-facing chat: this recipe is parent-led, and the parent records what happened.
